title: Exploring the changes of brain immune microenvironment in Alzheimer's disease based on PANDA algorithm combined with blood brain barrier injury-related genes.
authors: Lu, Shiting; Kong, Wei; Wang, Shuaiqun
one_liner_zh: 该文基于PANDA算法研究阿尔茨海默病中血脑屏障损伤相关基因与脑免疫微环境变化，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或相关建模方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Studies have shown that the specific entry of peripheral cells into the brain parenchyma caused by BBB injury and the imbalance of the immune microenvironment in the brain are closely related to the pathogenesis of Alzheimer's disease (AD). Because of the difficulty of obtaining data inside the brain, it is urgent to find out the relationship between the peripheral and intracerebral data and their influence on the development of AD by machine learning methods. However, in the actual algorithm design, it is still a challenge to extract relevant information from a variety of data to establish a complete and accurate regulatory network. In order to overcome the above difficulties, we presented a method based on a message passing model (Passing Attributes between Networks for Data Assimilation, PANDA) to discover the correlation between internal and external brain by the BBB injury-related genes, and further explore their regulatory mechanism of the brain immune environment for AD pathology. The Biological analysis of the results showed that pathways such as immune response pathway, inflammatory response pathway and chemokine signaling pathway are closely related to the pathogenesis of AD. Especially, some significant genes such as RELA, LAMA4, PPBP were found play certain roles in the injury of BBB and the change of permeability in AD patients, thus leading to the change of immune microenvironment in AD brain.
abstract_zh: 研究表明，血脑屏障（BBB）损伤导致的外周细胞特异性进入脑实质以及脑内免疫微环境失衡，与阿尔茨海默病（AD）的发病机制密切相关。由于脑内数据获取困难，亟需通过机器学习方法探索外周与脑内数据之间的关联及其对AD发展的影响。然而，在实际算法设计中，从多种数据中提取相关信息以建立完整且准确的调控网络仍是一大挑战。为克服上述困难，我们提出了一种基于消息传递模型（网络间属性传递用于数据同化，PANDA）的方法，利用与BBB损伤相关的基因发现脑内外之间的相关性，并进一步探讨其对AD病理中脑免疫环境的调控机制。结果的生物学分析显示，免疫应答通路、炎症应答通路和趋化因子信号通路等与AD发病机制密切相关。特别是，发现了一些重要基因如RELA、LAMA4、PPBP，在AD患者BBB损伤及通透性改变中发挥一定作用，从而导致AD脑内免疫微环境的变化。
